preconditions.description: The number of houses N is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
There are exactly N-1 road descriptions provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct houses with valid indices between 1 and N.
The graph formed by the houses and roads is a connected tree (N nodes, N-1 edges, connected).

postconditions.description: The output assignment contains exactly N integers.
The assignment is a permutation of house numbers 1 to N (each house is assigned to exactly one villager).

postconditions.expression: all(assignment[i] != i + 1 for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: No villager moves to their original house (derangement constraint).

postconditions.expression: total_distance == sum(dist(i + 1, assignment[i]) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The first line of output equals the sum of shortest path distances between original and new houses for all villagers.
The calculated total distance is the minimum possible among all valid derangements.
